summary: Verified two text-content updates on the static Spanish frontend for The Squared Room (Mettle Program). Loaded live preview, verified the DEPORTE FUNCIONAL paragraph now shows the new 'fusiona la fuerza explosiva del CrossTraining...' copy and confirmed the OLD wording ('combina lo mejor de dos mundos', 'del running o del cardio funcional') is not present. Expanded the 'Tus coaches funcionales' accordion in the coach section and confirmed the 'Podemos ayudarte si' list renders '¿Quieres estar en forma en tu día a día?' as the first item followed by the HYROX/DEKA item.
critical_code_review_comments: HybridSportSection.jsx hardcodes the DEPORTE FUNCIONAL paragraph (lines 14-19) instead of consuming hybridSportSection.description from mockData.js. Both were kept in sync manually, but this duplication (already updated) is a maintenance risk — consider rendering hybridSportSection.description directly and using a small formatter for bold spans, or moving the JSX segments into a structured data model.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Static Spanish React site at https://turquoise-gym.preview.emergentagent.com. No backend/APIs. Content lives in /app/frontend/src/data/mockData.js. Note: HybridSportSection.jsx hardcodes the DEPORTE FUNCIONAL paragraph text with <span> bolding, while mockData.js has hybridSportSection.description as a plain string — any future copy change must be applied in BOTH places or the JSX should be refactored to consume description.
